selectionRationale: Narrowly addresses owner-visible delayed playback and scrolling resource use without replacing the approved Android video player, degrading resolution or adding expensive native/build dependencies. SDK native ad assets preload one nearby slot before its appearance; no offscreen NativeAdView, early impression or banner prefetch; respect consent and request pacing.
Scoped release manifest and feature-specific tests pass protected feature lock; Android TypeScript bundle/Expo parity must pass before any staging OTA.
Compile actual Android staging-identity JS bundle on exact DEV candidate head without uploading or publishing any OTA.
All overlapping code hunks applied uniquely; no replacing newer staging-owned UI.
No native/plugin, Supabase/HC, SALIKSIK, IGPAT public feature, Android package or AdMob unit delta.
Exact-head CI and Android Hermes export before staging OTA; owner waives only manual handset check.
Production only after staging exact-source receipt/readback and separate production release gates.
Profile monthly/all-time signed-in rank and canonical Top 10 display without displacing personal posts; QMP/AdMob balances unchanged.
